target_customer: Specialty clinics, starting with veterinary practices and extending to dental and other clinics
problem: Clinics miss calls and lose appointments because front desk staff cannot handle scheduling, refills, intake and follow ups around the clock.
business_model: Subscription with fixed fee pricing for small clinics and usage based pricing for larger ones, per the company's launch pitch as reported

founders.name: Dominik Moehrle
founders.background_notes: YC page says he built and scaled four healthcare products.

founders.name: Julius Hillebrand
founders.background_notes: Bootstrapped an investment tool to over $2M AUM per the YC page.

founders.name: Tim Reinhart
founders.background_notes: Built autonomous drone systems at a robotics lab per the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Voice and text agents that integrate with veterinary and dental practice management systems need reliable low latency calls and many integrations.

defensibility.rationale: Practice system integrations and workflow data help retention, but many AI receptionist products target the same clinics.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Weave bought the AI receptionist company TrueLark in May 2025 and announced its own AI receptionist in April 2026. Dodo was not acquired as far as found.

market_need_then: Clinics were short of front desk staff and missed calls, and voice AI became usable in 2023 and 2024.

branding.domain_note: Uses dodo.ai. Acquisition history not found.

identity.logo: Green wordmark with a dodo bird icon
identity.voice_and_tone: Short punchy headlines ending in periods, such as Never miss a call.

brand_strength.rationale: A memorable animal name that suits veterinary clinics, but the dodo is an extinct bird, the name is shared with several other companies, and no press about the brand was found.

outcome_analysis: Dodo is a YC S24 team with Stanford trained founders selling AI communications agents to clinics, and its own site claims over 1,000 clinics, which is unverified. No credible funding round beyond the YC deal was found, and aggregator figures conflict. Its trajectory depends on holding vertical integrations against Weave and many AI receptionist rivals.
notes: Aggregators list a $500K round from Y Combinator around June to September 2024; this is the YC deal and is not recorded as a round. A $1.74M seed in 2026 appears on CB Insights only and is unverified. $3M and $66.6M totals on other aggregators appear to be data mix ups with Dodo Pizza or Dodo Payments. No SEC Form D was found. No dated 2024 competitor sources were found, so the list is empty. Customer counts are company claims.
